parsed.reason: Description A says the finally block overwrites the backoff next_run with now + job.interval, so failed jobs wait a full interval instead of retrying after retry_delay. Description B says the exponent 2**(consecutive_failures-1) can overflow timedelta and raise OverflowError inside the except block. These are different failures (wrong scheduling override versus arithmetic overflow), even though both involve the same retry/backoff area.
